crossRefs.note: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers, her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on…
The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods…
So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save…
King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and king…
“Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who…
For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus, which struck him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped…
Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you to go on the way to Assyria…
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be…

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

translations.web: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.
translations.bsb: Then you prostituted yourself with the Assyrians, because you were not yet satisfied. Even after that, you were still not satisfied.
translations.kjv: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
translations.asv: Thou hast played the harlot also with the Assyrians, because thou wast insatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet thou wast not satisfied.
